headline: Senate approves supplementary budget that raises fiscal deficit in the Dominican Republic
summary: The Dominican Senate approved urgently, in two consecutive readings, a bill modifying the 2026 General State Budget. It adds 54,100 million pesos in spending and raises the fiscal deficit, with the ruling majority in favour.
why: A larger budget deficit typically means more government borrowing, which can affect sovereign debt pricing and the outlook for the national currency.
original_headline: Senado aprueba presupuesto complementario que eleva déficit fiscal en República Dominicana
